methodology.purpose: Refine zero-survivor result without weakening certification gates
methodology.near_certification_contract: Both full years satisfy N>=100, coverage>=80%, positive thesis return and existing horizon effect floor; only FDR may fail and q must be <=0.20
methodology.hierarchical_testing: Diagnostic only; worst full-year p, BH within family and BH across family minima; cannot retroactively certify
methodology.symbol_concentration: Membership concentration from matched candidate observation keys; not return-contribution attribution
methodology.prohibited: No post-hoc relaxation of q<=0.10, coverage>=80%, N>=100, or effect floors
